annotations.title: Search short courses and work certificates

description: Search published short courses/work certificates by keyword and state. Includes courses without providers or upcoming classes unless explicitly filtered. Class summaries are for discovery only; call get_short_course before recommending a specific date or fee.

hasUpcomingClasses.description: Filter catalog records with (true) or without (false) future classes, including today. Does not confirm available seats; get_short_course refreshes schedules.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

name: search_short_courses
